role: @Observable sub-object of WorkoutRecorder holding live workout HR metrics so HR chips re-render only on HR changes.
toplevel: Stored-property defaults: currentHR nil, peakHR 0, beatCount 0. Instance is WorkoutRecorder.workoutHR (WorkoutRecorder.swift:50).

units.does: Resets currentHR to nil, peakHR to 0 and beatCount to 0. Called from WorkoutSessionLifecycle start (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:287) and resetRecorderStateAfterStop (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:230).
